keyResults.statement: For the Borromean rings B, lim (1/n) log |J_{B,n}(e^{2 pi i/n})| = vol(S^3 - B)/(2 pi); proved via Habiro's cyclotomic formula for the Borromean colored Jones.
keyResults.useForFolio: The literature input that licenses identifying QOU's explicitly-DEFINED borromeanKashaev sum with the Kashaev invariant / colored Jones at the root of unity, i.e. the epistemic hinge of BorromeanVolume.lean.
